corpus.permitted_source: Open Food Facts selected nutrition-panel images
corpus.split_algorithm: sha256(image_sha256 + ':' + panel_id) first byte: 0-152 tuning, 153-255 untouched_gate

mutations: multiply one per-serving ordinary nutrient by 10
swap per-100 and per-serving header bindings
replace one bounded value with an exact value

scoring.cell_exactness: comparator, decimal text, unit and bound basis must all match ground truth
scoring.false_save: any incorrect or unbound proposed table marked ready_for_confirmation without an unresolved warning; automatic persistence remains unavailable
scoring.full_table_exactness: all expected rows, cells, hierarchy, headers and bases exact with no extra accepted cells
scoring.ground_truth_source: human visual transcription from the source crop; source OCR and contributor nutriments are hints only
scoring.normalization: Unicode NFC and whitespace collapse are allowed for labels; numeric decimal text, comparator and unit are not rewritten for exact scoring
scoring.row_header_binding: canonical nutrient, parent relationship and column header basis must all match
